identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of SKB264 for Locally Advanced, Recurrent or Metastatic HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Phase 3 Study of SKB264 Versus Treatment of Physician's Choice (TPC) in Patients With Unresectable Locally Advanced, Recurrent or Metastatic HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer Who Had Failed at Least One Line of Chemotherapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SKB264 in patients with unresectable locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a randomized, open-label, multicenter Phase 3 clinical study to evaluate SKB264 monotherapy versus Treatment of Physician's Choice (TPC) in subjects with unresectable locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer who had failed at least one line of systemic chemotherapy.

armGroups.label: Treatment of Physician's Choice
armGroups.description: Eribulin, capecitabine, gemcitabine or vinorelbine will be administered and managed according to the investigator's clinical judgment, guided by clinical practice.

interventions.name: SKB264
interventions.description: IV infusion on day 1 and Day 15 of each 28 day cycle

interventions.name: Eribulin
interventions.description: 1.4 mg/m2, IV infusion on day 1 and Day 8 of each 21 day cycle

interventions.name: Capecitabine
interventions.description: 1000-1250 mg/m2, po, bid, from day 1 to Day 15 of each 21 day cycle

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: 1000 mg/m2, IV infusion on day 1 and Day 8 of each 21day cycle

interventions.name: Vinorelbine
interventions.description: 25 mg/m2, IV infusion on day 1 and Day 8 of each 21 day cycle

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by BIRC per RECIST 1.1.
primaryOutcomes.description: PFS, defined as the time from randomization to PD or death, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS, defined as the time from randomization to death

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by the investigators per RECIST V 1.1
secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS, defined as the time from randomization to PD or death, whichever occurs first.
The percentage of patients with CR and PR assessed by BIRC and investigators per RECIST v 1.1
The percentage of patients who have achieved CR，PR and SD assessed by BIRC and investigators per RECIST v 1.1
From the date that response criteria are first met to the first occurrence of PD as determined by BIRC and investigators per RECIST v1.1 or death from any cause, whichever occurs first

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Quality of life of patients evaluated using the European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer Quality of Life Questionnaire Core 30 (EORTC QLQ-C30) scale
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the impact of SKB264 on disease related symptoms and health related quality of life (HRQoL) in this patient population
Incidence and severity of AEs and SAEs (per CTCAE 5.0), and clinically significant abnormal laboratory findings
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: AEs should be observed and recorded from signing the ICF until 30 days after the last dose. AEs occurring 30 days after the last dose are not required to be actively collected by the investigator.

locations.facility: Cancer Hospital Chinese Academy of Medical Science
